title: 11 Minutes To Fix Your Running Form

quotes.src: I'm going to show you the exact system to fix your running form right now so you can start to run faster with less effort.
quotes.tgt: 我現在要直接給你一套修正跑姿的方法，讓你開始跑得更快、也更省力。

quotes.src: This step is so powerful that it helped one of my clients run 15 seconds faster per kilometer on their very next run.
quotes.tgt: 這一步效果很強，我有位學員在下一次跑步時，每公里立刻快了 15 秒。

quotes.src: The wear and tear on your racing shoes gives you clues to how you run.
quotes.tgt: 跑鞋上的磨損痕跡，會透露你是怎麼跑步的。

quotes.src: In a perfect world, the wear starts on the outside middle and finishes near the big toe.
quotes.tgt: 理想情況下，磨損會從鞋底外側中段開始，最後延伸到大拇趾附近。

quotes.src: Wear on the inside usually means you're rotating your feet outwards.
quotes.tgt: 如果內側磨損明顯，通常代表你落地時雙腳有外旋。

quotes.src: Wear and tear on the heels usually means you're landing out in front of your body — an overstride.
quotes.tgt: 如果鞋跟磨損很多，通常表示你落地點太靠身體前方，也就是跨步過大。

quotes.src: Imagine you've stepped in some chewing gum and now you're trying to wipe it off the ground with every step.
quotes.tgt: 想像你踩到口香糖，現在每一步都在地上把它擦掉。

quotes.src: Ask yourself one simple question: compared to others, are you faster on a hard surface or on a soft surface?
quotes.tgt: 問自己一個簡單問題：和別人相比，你在硬地跑比較快，還是在軟地跑比較快？

quotes.src: If you race on roads but you're muscle based, you're leaving speed on the table.
quotes.tgt: 如果你跑公路賽，但你的型態其實偏肌力主導，你就等於把速度白白留在場上。

quotes.src: Film yourself from three different angles: from the side, from the back, and from the front.
quotes.tgt: 從三個角度拍下自己：側面、後面、正面。

quotes.src: Overstriding isn't the problem. It's the symptom.
quotes.tgt: 跨步過大不是問題本身，它只是症狀。

quotes.src: Every time you find a problem, run this three-step process.
quotes.tgt: 每次你發現一個問題，就跑一次這個三步驟流程。

quotes.src: Most runners want to fix everything at once. That's a bad idea.
quotes.tgt: 多數跑者都想一次修好所有問題，這是壞主意。

quotes.src: Practice the thing you want to work on in short intervals inside of easy runs, then build gradually each week.
quotes.tgt: 把你想修正的動作放進輕鬆跑中的短區間反覆練習，再每週逐步增加。
